statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations accompanied by intermittent dizziness
A cardiac event monitoring study, CPT 93271, was ordered
The study was ordered for ambulatory assessment to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The submitted materials do not align with the records currently maintained in the insurer's system
